notes.title: 1.1.2 update
notes.notes:
New Content

Fullscreen Mode: You can now toggle fullscreen mode in the settings menu.

Firefly Effect: Added a sound effect when fireflies fade out, making it clearer when the lights go out.



Balance Adjustments

Adjusted the hint for the clock puzzle to make it easier to understand.



Bug Fixes

Fixed some audio issues where certain sounds were too loud. Volume now matches the settings menu configuration.

Fixed missing invisible walls that prevent falling out of the map.

Updated the "Choose a Route" UI for better clarity and ease of use.

notes.title: 1.1.1 update
notes.notes:

Bug Fixes

Fixed UI issues when switching controllers.

Fixed missing dialogues in the Turkish language.

notes.title: The Last Bloom 1.1 Update "No More Apple Pie" Available now!
notes.notes:
New Content

Localization: Now supports Thai and Turkish languages. You can switch languages in the settings menu. (More languages will be added in the future.)

Mystery Potion: Spawns randomly across the map. Curious about its effects? Give it a try! It might make your gameplay easier...or not.

Balloon-Themed Check Point: Added a new symbol for Check Points for better clarity.

Hidden Helper: A new feature to make your gameplay easier, but you’ll need to unlock it yourself!

Night-Only Event: A new event that occurs exclusively at night.

New Ending: Added one more unique ending.

New Secrets: Explore the game to uncover hidden surprises.

New Clues: Added hints to help you discover the game’s secrets more easily.

New Achievements: Added 2 new achievements.

FPS Limit Setting: Added an option to limit FPS in the settings menu.

Pause Menu: You can now press the ESC key to pause the game.



Balance Adjustments

Reduced the speed of monsters in the nighttime forest stage.

Slightly increased the speed of Wermut during both patrolling and chasing phases.

Increased stamina regeneration rate, but when stamina is below 30%, the cooldown for regeneration will be longer.

Reduced the number of Jumpscares in the nighttime stages.



Bug Fixes

Fixed UI issues when switching controllers.

Improved UI to make it more user-friendly and visually clear.

Fixed incorrect dialogues in some instances.
